s: July 9, 2025 - I have ordered a few times from Integy, I haven't had any problems from the parts I ordered. But the shipping times, shipping rules and no real way to contact customer service leaves a lot to be desired. They have 2 day shipping, but you won't receive it in 2 days, so why pay extra for a service you will not get.
